title: Parkio Daily for July 26, 2026
teaser: Expedition Everest single-rider line removed; Disney Springs happy hour now $12; new 40% hotel flash sale starts soon.

rides.note: Lower waits during dinner hour typically

breaking.title: Single-rider line removed at Expedition Everest
breaking.body: Animal Kingdom removed the dedicated single-rider entrance at Expedition Everest this week. The attraction still operates but guests now join the standard standby or Lightning Lane queues.

parkioInsight.text: Standby waits at Everest tend to climb 10–15 minutes higher without the single-rider option. Rope drop or late evening usually offers the shortest queues.

breaking.title: Emergency evacuations at Yacht Club and Beach Club resorts
breaking.body: Guests and cast members were evacuated from both Yacht Club and Beach Club resorts last night due to an unspecified emergency. Both properties have since resumed normal operations.

parkioInsight.text: If you have reservations at either resort this weekend, confirm room availability directly with the front desk. Overnight disruptions may still affect some services.

bignews.title: New 40% off resort hotel flash sale launching soon
bignews.body: Disney World will release a flash sale offering up to 40% off resort hotels for summer dates and beyond. The sale appears similar to last year's limited-time promotion and starts within days.

parkioInsight.text: Flash sales tend to vanish within 24–48 hours. Book the moment it opens if your travel dates are flexible—best inventory usually clears by day two.

bignews.title: Disney Springs restaurant adds $12 happy hour deal
bignews.body: A top-rated Disney Springs dining spot now offers a beer, burger, and dessert for $12 during happy hour. The promotion is available daily at select times.

parkioInsight.text: Happy hour slots tend to fill quickly on weekends. Arrive right at opening time or plan for a mid-afternoon snack break to secure a table.

bignews.title: Mickey's Not-So-Scary Halloween Party foodie guide released
bignews.body: Disney published the full list of treats and snacks available at this year's Halloween party, running August 7 through October 31. Menu highlights include new themed desserts and savory options across Magic Kingdom.

parkioInsight.text: Party-exclusive food tends to sell out by 9pm on peak nights. Grab your must-try items right after 7pm entry to avoid disappointment later.

bignews.title: Disneyland moves Christmas 2026 start date earlier
bignews.body: Disneyland pushed its holiday season start date forward by several days for Christmas 2026. Official decorations and seasonal overlays will now debut earlier than the original schedule.

parkioInsight.text: The first week of any seasonal rollout usually offers photo-ready decor with lighter crowds. Book tickets for the opening weekend if you want holiday magic without peak waits.

topstories.title: Eight rides averaged nearly hour-long waits this week
topstories.body: Wait times at eight Disney World attractions climbed close to 60 minutes on average over the past seven days as summer travel continues. The highest waits spanned all four parks.

parkioInsight.text: Mid-morning through early afternoon tends to push waits highest park-wide. Prioritize your top two rides at rope drop or return after 7pm when lines often thin.

topstories.title: Avengers Campus expansion construction progresses at California Adventure
topstories.body: New paint and scaffold removal are visible at the Avengers Campus expansion site, including freshly installed restrooms. Construction continues on additional facilities and theming.

parkioInsight.text: Construction noise near Avengers Campus tends to spike mid-morning. Plan character meet-and-greets or dining breaks in other lands if you're noise-sensitive.

topstories.title: Transportation restricted at one Disney World hotel
topstories.body: Bus and boat service from Disney Springs to certain resort hotels now requires proof of a dining reservation, hotel booking, or Enchanting Extras purchase. Cast members verify credentials before boarding.

parkioInsight.text: If you're planning a resort-hop for dining or shopping, book a reservation in advance. Walk-up arrivals may face denial of boarding without confirmation.

topstories.title: Hong Kong Disneyland announces Magic Run Fest marathon weekend
topstories.body: Hong Kong Disneyland revealed a new runDisney-style event called Magic Run Fest. The race weekend will include multiple distance options and park access for participants.

parkioInsight.text: International runDisney events tend to offer lower entry barriers than U.S. races. Registration usually opens months ahead—sign up early if you're considering a trip.

topstories.title: Character experiences guide published for Animal Kingdom
topstories.body: Disney released a detailed guide to all character greeting locations inside Animal Kingdom, covering times and meet-and-greet spots across the park.

parkioInsight.text: Character lines tend to be shortest in the first 90 minutes after rope drop. Knock out your must-meet characters early before heading to Flight of Passage.

topstories.title: D23 event shopping details revealed for Imagineering merchandise
topstories.body: Mickey's of Glendale will return to D23: The Ultimate Disney Fan Event in August with a new Walt Disney Imagineering collection. The booth typically draws heavy crowds for exclusive items.

parkioInsight.text: D23 merchandise lines can reach multi-hour waits on day one. Arrive at the booth during off-peak convention hours—usually late afternoon—for better odds.

icymi.title: Evermore Resort near Disney World adds new guest experiences
icymi.body: The Evermore Resort in Orlando launched additional activities and amenities for visitors staying near Walt Disney World. The property continues expanding its offerings for families.

icymi.title: California Grill sushi chef profile highlights guest-focused preparation
icymi.body: Disney profiled the lead sushi chef at California Grill, detailing how he tailors each dish to individual guest preferences and creates personalized dining experiences.

icymi.title: New Disney Worldbuilders documentary coming to Disney Plus in August
icymi.body: A behind-the-scenes documentary series called Disney Worldbuilders will premiere on Disney Plus next month, exploring how Imagineers design and build theme park lands and attractions.

spotlight.title: La Poutinerie debuts new snack at EPCOT Canada pavilion
spotlight.body: EPCOT's Canada pavilion now serves a fresh poutine option at La Poutinerie, drawing praise as one of the best new quick-service items in World Showcase. The dish is available daily.

parkioInsight.text: World Showcase kiosks tend to have the shortest lines mid-afternoon before dinner rush. Grab this snack between 2–4pm to skip the wait.
